title: Petition of NSTAR Electric Company to construct and operate a new overhead 345-kV transmission line, and related facility improvements in the Towns of Carver, Plymouth, Bourne and Barnstable pursuant to G.L. c. 164, §§ 69H and 69J. NSTAR Electric Company files petition for exemptions from zoning ordinances and by-laws in the towns of Carver, Plymouth, Bourne and Barnstable, pursuant to G.L. c.40A, § 3; and a petition for construction & operation of a new 345kV overhead transmission line and related facilities pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 72.
